agenda_items.title: Self-Regulating Software Ontology — JSON Schema for Contract Coverage Scanning, Drift Detection, and Autonomous Remediation
agenda_items.intent_description: Complete JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) ontology for a self-regulating software system that scans codebases for TypeSpec/OpenAPI/Protobuf contract coverage, detects drift between contracts and implementations, and autonomously remediates gaps. Schema covers: Codebase (version-controlled repo with modules), Module (deployable unit with API endpoints), ContractDefinition (TypeSpec/OpenAPI/Protobuf specs), ContractStatus (coverage type: full/partial/none/stale), DriftReport (7 drift types with severity), SelfRegulationAction (9 action types), and RegulationPolicy (governance rules for auto-remediation).
requirements: Full JSON Schema with 15+ type definitions
7 drift types: missing_endpoint, missing_operation, signature_mismatch, extra_endpoint, model_divergence, method_mismatch, path_mismatch
9 regulation actions: generate_typespec, update_typespec, generate_client_sdk, generate_server_stub, regenerate_openapi, flag_for_review, block_deployment, auto_fix_signature, notify_owner
Coverage states: full, partial, none, stale
RegulationPolicy: requireContractForNewModules, blockDeployOnDrift, autoGenerateTypespec, autoGenerateClients, maxAllowedDriftSeverity
Technology support: Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Scala, Go, Rust with frameworks

agenda_items.title: Self-Regulation Action Framework — 9 Autonomous Corrective Actions with Lifecycle
agenda_items.intent_description: Define nine self-regulation actions the system can autonomously take: generate_typespec (create new contract from module), update_typespec (update existing contract), generate_client_sdk (auto-generate SDK from contract), generate_server_stub (generate server stub from contract), regenerate_openapi (regenerate OpenAPI from TypeSpec), flag_for_review (human escalation), block_deployment (prevent deployment on drift), auto_fix_signature (auto-correct method signature mismatches), notify_owner (notify module owner). Each action has lifecycle: pending → in_progress → completed/failed/aborted. Triggered by scan, CI pipeline, drift detection, or manual intervention.
requirements: 9 action types with specific targets per type
Lifecycle: pending, in_progress, completed, failed, aborted
Drift severity levels: critical, warning, info
RegulationPolicy controls which actions are automatic vs require human approval

agenda_items.title: Contract Coverage Scanning Pipeline — Module-to-TypeSpec Mapping with Drift Detection
agenda_items.intent_description: Design a scanning pipeline that maps every module in a codebase to its corresponding TypeSpec/OpenAPI contract definition. The ScanReport aggregates: total modules, modules with contracts, modules without contracts, modules with drift. Per-module scans: module path, technology stack, endpoint count, covered endpoint count, drift detection results. Coverage gaps are identified and prioritized (critical/high/medium/low). Drift types include missing endpoints, signature mismatches, model divergence, path mismatches, and method mismatches.
requirements: ScanReport: scanId, codebasePath, timestamp, totalModules, modulesWithContracts, modulesWithoutContracts, modulesWithDrift
ModuleScanReport: module name, path, technology, endpoint counts, drift details
CoverageGap: module name, path, technology, endpoint count, priority, suggested TypeSpec path and namespace
Drift detection at module operation level
7 drift types with expected vs actual comparison
